## Motivation

- In MXFP4 MLA decode on ROCm gfx95 (Kimi-K2.5-MXFP4), the absorbed value projection is a batched A16W4 GEMM that writes a BF16 tensor.
- `o_proj` immediately quantizes that tensor back to MXFP4 with `fused_flatten_mxfp4_quant`: one extra launch and a BF16 HBM round trip per MLA layer per decode step.
- Quantizing in the GEMM epilogue removes both. The kernel is 1.19-1.41x faster than the split pair at 1-64 decode tokens (table below).
- Independent of #32935 (key projection + RoPE + KV-cache write fusion).

## Modifications

- New Triton kernel `batched_gemm_a16wfp4_flatten_mxfp4_quant` in `sglang.kernels.ops.gemm.mla_value_bmm_mxfp4_hip`, registered as `gemm.batched_gemm_a16wfp4_flatten_mxfp4_quant` (Triton, HIP).
  - GEMM body derived from AITER `batched_gemm_a16wfp4`; uses AITER's tuned config lookup.
  - Keeps the split path's BF16 rounding point, so values and scales match it bit for bit.
  - Batch size stays out of the compile key, and out-of-range e8m0 scales are masked as in AITER.
- `rocm_absorb_v_bmm` uses it during AITER decode when `w_vc` and `o_proj` are MXFP4.
- Works in eager mode, `torch.compile` and HIP graph capture.

| New env var | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `SGLANG_OPT_HIP_FUSE_MLA_VALUE_MXFP4_QUANT` | `true` | `false` keeps the split GEMM + `fused_flatten_mxfp4_quant` |

Fused path conditions (anything else keeps the split path):

| Condition | Required |
|---|---|
| Platform | ROCm gfx95 with AITER |
| Forward mode / backend | decode or idle, `aiter` attention backend |
| Weights | MXFP4 `w_vc` and MXFP4 `o_proj` |
| Shape | `kv_lora_rank` 512, `v_head_dim` 128 (Kimi-K2.5; also DeepSeek-V3/R1 MXFP4) |
| Excluded | DSA, active LoRA on `kv_b_proj`, `SGLANG_EXPERIMENTAL_LORA_OPTI` |
| Kernel config | AITER config with `NUM_KSPLIT == 1` and `BLOCK_SIZE_N` dividing N; otherwise the op runs the split path internally |

## Accuracy Tests

GSM8K, Kimi-K2.5-MXFP4, 4x MI355X, TP4, FP8 KV cache, 1319 questions, 8-shot, 512 new tokens, fusion on: **0.936** (threshold 0.92).

Re-measured on this head (`cd455d078b`) with sgl-eval, on/off in parallel on one node (two rounds, GPU groups swapped between them):

| Round | `SGLANG_OPT_HIP_FUSE_MLA_VALUE_MXFP4_QUANT=1` | `=0` |
|---|---:|---:|
| 1 (on: GPUs 0-3) | 95.91%, 22 errors (server fault, below) | 97.19% |
| 2 (on: GPUs 4-7) | 96.89% | 96.97% |

- Command: `sgl-eval 0.1.3 run gsm8k --num-threads 64 --temperature 1.0 --top-p 0.95 --thinking --max-tokens 32768` (full 1319; Moonshot's thinking-mode sampling, no sgl-eval preset for K2.5). Round 2 and round 1's completed answers (97.5% of 1297) are within sampling noise (stderr ~0.5 pp).
- Server: `amd/Kimi-K2.5-MXFP4`, TP4 per arm, `SGLANG_USE_AITER=1`, `--attention-backend aiter --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 --mem-fraction-static 0.8 --reasoning-parser kimi_k2 --max-running-requests 64 --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 64`. ROCm/aiter stack @ `f9b5308b2`.
- In round 1 the fusion-on server died near the end with `HSA_STATUS_ERROR_EXCEPTION` (code 0x1016) during long-context graph decode, so its last 22 requests failed. The same fault hit a `main` build without this kernel on the same machine, and round 2 ran clean, so it is not from this PR.

| Test | Result |
|---|---|
| `test/registered/kernels/ops/gemm/test_mla_value_bmm_mxfp4_hip.py` (MI35x): values and scales equal the split path bit for bit at 1, 17 and 64 tokens; `torch.compile`, graph replay, config-lookup fallback | 4 passed |
| `TestValueQuantFusionGate` in `test/registered/unit/models/test_rocm_mla_absorb_fusion_gate.py` (CPU) | 3 passed |

- Latest head: both files pass together on MI355X (13 passed).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Kernel, one MI355X, 16 heads, N=128, K=512, pinned AITER `285579b6`:

- One HIP graph replays over 1 GiB of rotated inputs (4x the Infinity Cache, so reads are cold); split and fused interleaved; median of 50, 3 runs.
- Benchmark: `test/manual/kernels/benchmark/gemm/bench_mla_value_bmm_mxfp4_hip.py`.

| Decode tokens | Split | Fused | Speedup |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 9.15 us | 6.47 us | 1.41x |
| 4 | 10.17 us | 8.54 us | 1.19x |
| 16 | 12.18 us | 9.81 us | 1.24x |
| 64 | 18.39 us | 15.19 us | 1.21x |

## Checklist

- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).

+_MXFP4_QUANT_BLOCK_SIZE_TL = tl.constexpr(_MXFP4_QUANT_BLOCK_SIZE)
+
+
+@triton.heuristics(
+    {
+        "EVEN_K": lambda args: (
+            args["K"] % (args["BLOCK_SIZE_K"] // 2) == 0
+            and args["K"] % (args["SPLITK_BLOCK_SIZE"] // 2) == 0
+        ),
+    }
+)
+@triton.jit
+def _batched_gemm_a16wfp4_flatten_mxfp4_quant_kernel(
+    a_ptr,
+    b_ptr,
+    b_scales_ptr,
+    out_ptr,
+    out_scales_ptr,
+    M,
+    N,
+    K,
+    stride_ab,
+    stride_am,
+    stride_ak,
+    stride_bb,
+    stride_bn,
+    stride_bk,
+    stride_bsb,
+    stride_bsn,
+    stride_bsk,
+    stride_om,
+    stride_on,
+    stride_osm,
+    stride_osn,
+    BLOCK_SIZE_M: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_SIZE_N: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_SIZE_K: tl.constexpr,
+    GROUP_SIZE_M: tl.constexpr,
+    NUM_KSPLIT: tl.constexpr,
+    SPLITK_BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
+    EVEN_K: tl.constexpr,
+    cache_modifier: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    """Batched A16W4 GEMM with a flattened MXFP4 output epilogue."""
+    pid_batch = tl.program_id(axis=0)
+    pid = tl.program_id(axis=1)
+    num_pid_m = tl.cdiv(M, BLOCK_SIZE_M)
+    num_pid_n = tl.cdiv(N, BLOCK_SIZE_N)
+
+    # This epilogue must see the complete accumulator before quantizing it.
+    tl.static_assert(NUM_KSPLIT == 1)
+    tl.static_assert(BLOCK_SIZE_N % _MXFP4_QUANT_BLOCK_SIZE_TL == 0)
+
+    # Runtime grid size, as in AITER: a constexpr would compile one binary per batch size.
+    remap_xcd(pid, num_pid_m * num_pid_n)
+    pid_m, pid_n = pid_grid(pid, num_pid_m, num_pid_n, GROUP_SIZE_M=GROUP_SIZE_M)
+
+    stride_ab = tl.cast(stride_ab, tl.int64)
+    stride_bb = tl.cast(stride_bb, tl.int64)
+    pid_batch_i64 = tl.cast(pid_batch, tl.int64)
+
+    offs_k_bf16 = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_K)
+    offs_am = (pid_m * BLOCK_SIZE_M + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_M)) % M
+    a_ptrs = (
+        a_ptr
+        + pid_batch_i64 * stride_ab
+        + offs_am[:, None] * stride_am
+        + offs_k_bf16[None, :] * stride_ak
+    )
+
+    offs_k = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_K // 2)
+    offs_bn = (pid_n * BLOCK_SIZE_N + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_N)) % N
+    b_ptrs = (
+        b_ptr
+        + pid_batch_i64 * stride_bb
+        + offs_k[:, None] * stride_bk
+        + offs_bn[None, :] * stride_bn
+    )
+
+    scale_group_size: tl.constexpr = _MXFP4_QUANT_BLOCK_SIZE_TL
+    offs_ks = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_K // scale_group_size)
+    b_scale_ptrs = (
+        b_scales_ptr
+        + pid_batch_i64 * stride_bsb
+        + offs_bn[:, None] * stride_bsn
+        + offs_ks[None, :] * stride_bsk
+    )
+
+    accumulator = tl.zeros((BLOCK_SIZE_M, BLOCK_SIZE_N), dtype=tl.float32)
+    num_k_iter: tl.constexpr = tl.cdiv(SPLITK_BLOCK_SIZE // 2, BLOCK_SIZE_K // 2)
+    for k in range(0, num_k_iter):
+        if EVEN_K:
+            b_scales = tl.load(b_scale_ptrs)
+            a_bf16 = tl.load(a_ptrs)
+            b = tl.load(b_ptrs, cache_modifier=cache_modifier)
+        else:
+            # As in AITER: OOB e8m0 scale bytes may be 0xFF (NaN); read them as 127 (2^0).
+            scale_mask = offs_ks[None, :] < (
+                2 * K // scale_group_size - k * (BLOCK_SIZE_K // scale_group_size)
+            )
+            b_scales = tl.load(b_scale_ptrs, mask=scale_mask, other=127)
+            logical_k = 2 * K
+            a_bf16 = tl.load(
+                a_ptrs,
+                mask=offs_k_bf16[None, :] < logical_k - k * BLOCK_SIZE_K,
+                other=0,
+            )
+            b = tl.load(
+                b_ptrs,
+                mask=offs_k[:, None] < K - k * (BLOCK_SIZE_K // 2),
+                other=0,
+            )
+
+        a, a_scales = _mxfp4_quant_op(
+            a_bf16,
+            BLOCK_SIZE_K,
+            BLOCK_SIZE_M,
+            scale_group_size,
+        )
+        accumulator = tl.dot_scaled(
+            a,
+            a_scales,
+            "e2m1",
+            b,
+            b_scales,
+            "e2m1",
+            acc=accumulator,
+        )
+
+        a_ptrs += BLOCK_SIZE_K * stride_ak
+        b_ptrs += (BLOCK_SIZE_K // 2) * stride_bk
+        b_scale_ptrs += (BLOCK_SIZE_K // scale_group_size) * stride_bsk
+
+    # Preserve the split path's BF16 boundary before dynamic output quantization.
+    rounded = accumulator.to(tl.bfloat16).to(tl.float32)
+    out, out_scales = _mxfp4_quant_op(
+        rounded,
+        BLOCK_SIZE_N,
+        BLOCK_SIZE_M,
+        scale_group_size,
+    )
+
+    offs_m = pid_m * BLOCK_SIZE_M + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_M)
+    offs_out_n = (
+        pid_batch * (N // 2)
+        + pid_n * (BLOCK_SIZE_N // 2)
+        + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_N // 2)
+    )
+    tl.store(
+        out_ptr + offs_m[:, None] * stride_om + offs_out_n[None, :] * stride_on,
+        out,
+        mask=offs_m[:, None] < M,
+    )
+
+    num_quant_blocks: tl.constexpr = BLOCK_SIZE_N // _MXFP4_QUANT_BLOCK_SIZE_TL
+    offs_scale_n = (
+        pid_batch * (N // _MXFP4_QUANT_BLOCK_SIZE_TL)
+        + pid_n * num_quant_blocks
+        + tl.arange(0, num_quant_blocks)
+    )
+    tl.store(
+        out_scales_ptr
+        + offs_m[:, None] * stride_osm
+        + offs_scale_n[None, :] * stride_osn,
+        out_scales,
+        mask=offs_m[:, None] < M,
+    )
+
+
+def _get_fused_config(x: torch.Tensor, w: torch.Tensor) -> dict | None:
+    _, m, logical_k = x.shape
+    _, n, packed_k = w.shape
+    if logical_k != 2 * packed_k or n % _MXFP4_QUANT_BLOCK_SIZE != 0:
+        return None
+
+    config, _ = _get_config(m, n, packed_k)
+    if (
+        config["NUM_KSPLIT"] != 1
+        or config["BLOCK_SIZE_N"] % _MXFP4_QUANT_BLOCK_SIZE != 0
+        or n % config["BLOCK_SIZE_N"] != 0
+    ):
+        return None
+    return config
+
+
+def _batched_gemm_a16wfp4_flatten_mxfp4_quant(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    w: torch.Tensor,
+    w_scales: torch.Tensor,
+    out: torch.Tensor,
+    out_scales: torch.Tensor,
+) -> None:
+    batch, m, _ = x.shape
+    _, n, packed_k = w.shape
+    config = _get_fused_config(x, w)
+    if config is None:
+        bf16_output = torch.empty((m, batch, n), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=x.device)
+        batched_gemm_afp4wfp4_pre_quant(
+            x,
+            w,
+            w_scales,
+            torch.bfloat16,
+            bf16_output.transpose(0, 1),
+        )
+        split_out, split_scales = fused_flatten_mxfp4_quant(bf16_output)
+        out.copy_(split_out)
+        out_scales.copy_(split_scales)
+        return
+
+    config = dict(config)
+    config["SPLITK_BLOCK_SIZE"] = 2 * packed_k
+    if config["BLOCK_SIZE_K"] >= 2 * packed_k:
+        config["BLOCK_SIZE_K"] = triton.next_power_of_2(2 * packed_k)
+
+    grid = lambda meta: (  # noqa: E731
+        batch,
+        triton.cdiv(m, meta["BLOCK_SIZE_M"]) * triton.cdiv(n, meta["BLOCK_SIZE_N"]),
+    )
+    _batched_gemm_a16wfp4_flatten_mxfp4_quant_kernel[grid](
+        x,
+        w,
+        w_scales,
+        out,
+        out_scales,
+        m,
+        n,
+        packed_k,
+        *x.stride(),
+        *w.stride(),
+        *w_scales.stride(),
+        *out.stride(),
+        *out_scales.stride(),
+        **config,
+    )
+
+
+def _batched_gemm_a16wfp4_flatten_mxfp4_quant_fake(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    w: torch.Tensor,
+    w_scales: torch.Tensor,
+    out: torch.Tensor,
+    out_scales: torch.Tensor,

+    return None
+
+
+direct_register_custom_op(
+    op_name="batched_gemm_a16wfp4_flatten_mxfp4_quant",
+    op_func=_batched_gemm_a16wfp4_flatten_mxfp4_quant,
+    mutates_args=["out", "out_scales"],
+    fake_impl=_batched_gemm_a16wfp4_flatten_mxfp4_quant_fake,
+)
+
+
+def can_fuse_mla_value_bmm_mxfp4_quant(
+    x: torch.Tensor, w: torch.Tensor, w_scales: torch.Tensor
+) -> bool:
+    return (
+        x.is_cuda
+        and x.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+        and w.dtype == torch.uint8
+        and w_scales.dtype == torch.uint8
+        and x.device == w.device == w_scales.device
+        and x.dim() == w.dim() == w_scales.dim() == 3
+        and x.shape[0] == w.shape[0] == w_scales.shape[0]
+        and w.shape[1] == w_scales.shape[1]
+        and w.shape[2] * 2 == x.shape[2]
+        and w_scales.shape[2] * _MXFP4_QUANT_BLOCK_SIZE == x.shape[2]
+        # The pinned Kimi shape has a non-split AITER config; checking the shape keeps
+        # graph tracing free of the config lookup, which the custom op redoes at launch.
+        and w.shape[1] == 128
+        and x.shape[2] == 512
+    )

+    if not can_fuse_mla_value_bmm_mxfp4_quant(x, w, w_scales):

+            "batched dimensions, and the Kimi N=128, K=512 value shape"

+    n = w.shape[1]

+        (m, batch * n // 2),
+        dtype=torch.uint8,
+        device=x.device,

+        x, w, w_scales, out, out_scales
+    )
+    return out, out_scales
+

+__all__ = [
+    "batched_gemm_a16wfp4_flatten_mxfp4_quant",
+    "can_fuse_mla_value_bmm_mxfp4_quant",
+]

+"""Benchmark fused Kimi MLA value projection and MXFP4 output quantization.
+
+Each path replays one CUDA graph over rotated copies of x, W and W scales,
+totaling ROTATE_BYTES so every call reads its inputs cold from HBM;
+on MI355X that must exceed the 256 MB Infinity Cache, not only the 4 MB per-XCD L2.
+Reports the median replay.
+
+Run: ``python test/manual/kernels/benchmark/gemm/bench_mla_value_bmm_mxfp4_hip.py``
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import math
+import statistics
+
+import torch
+from aiter.ops.triton.batched_gemm_afp4wfp4_pre_quant import (
+    batched_gemm_afp4wfp4_pre_quant,
+)
+from aiter.ops.triton.fused_mxfp4_quant import fused_flatten_mxfp4_quant
+from aiter.ops.triton.quant import dynamic_mxfp4_quant
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.gemm.mla_value_bmm_mxfp4_hip import (
+    batched_gemm_a16wfp4_flatten_mxfp4_quant,
+)
+
+N, K = 128, 512
+# 4x the MI355X 256 MB Infinity Cache.
+ROTATE_BYTES = 1 << 30
+
+
+def split(x, w, w_scales):
+    heads, tokens, _ = x.shape
+    bf16_output = torch.empty((tokens, heads, N), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
+    batched_gemm_afp4wfp4_pre_quant(
+        x, w, w_scales, torch.bfloat16, bf16_output.transpose(0, 1)
+    )
+    return fused_flatten_mxfp4_quant(bf16_output)
+
+
+def make_inputs(heads, tokens):
+    weight = torch.randn((heads * N, K), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
+    w, w_scales = dynamic_mxfp4_quant(weight)
+    w = w.view(heads, N, K // 2)
+    w_scales = w_scales.view(heads, N, K // 32)
+    x = torch.randn((heads, tokens, K), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
+    nbytes = sum(t.numel() * t.element_size() for t in (x, w, w_scales))
+    copies = math.ceil(ROTATE_BYTES / nbytes)
+    return [(x.clone(), w.clone(), w_scales.clone()) for _ in range(copies)]
+
+
+def capture(fn, inputs):
+    for args in inputs[:3]:
+        fn(*args)
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+        for args in inputs:
+            fn(*args)
+    graph.replay()
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    return graph
+
+
+def time_ms(graph):
+    start = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)
+    end = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)
+    start.record()
+    graph.replay()
+    end.record()
+    end.synchronize()
+    return start.elapsed_time(end)
+
+
+def bench_us(fns, inputs, replays):
+    graphs = [capture(fn, inputs) for fn in fns]
+    # Interleave replays so every path sees the same background load.
+    times_ms = [[] for _ in graphs]
+    for _ in range(replays):
+        for graph, times in zip(graphs, times_ms):
+            times.append(time_ms(graph))
+    del graphs
+    torch.cuda.empty_cache()
+    return [statistics.median(t) * 1e3 / len(inputs) for t in times_ms]
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--heads", type=int, default=16)
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--tokens", type=int, nargs="+", default=[1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64]
+    )
+    parser.add_argument("--replays", type=int, default=50)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    print(f"{'tokens':>8} {'split (us)':>12} {'fused (us)':>12} {'speedup':>10}")
+    for tokens in args.tokens:
+        inputs = make_inputs(args.heads, tokens)
+        split_us, fused_us = bench_us(
+            (split, batched_gemm_a16wfp4_flatten_mxfp4_quant), inputs, args.replays
+        )
+        print(
+            f"{tokens:>8} {split_us:>12.3f} {fused_us:>12.3f} "
+            f"{split_us / fused_us:>10.3f}"
+        )
+        del inputs
+        torch.cuda.empty_cache()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
